_comment: Canonical BNB Smart Chain testnet (chainId 97) per-asset risk params. JSON is the single source of truth for deploy + front + sim + docs.

_network.name: BNB Smart Chain Testnet
_network.note: Chapel is Binance's internal codename for BSC testnet — same chain as chainId 97.

_units.minFeeBps: PBPS on-chain (Asset.minFeeBps). 100 PBPS = 1 bp = 0.01%. 1 PBPS = 0.0001% = 0.01 bp. Protocol floor: MIN_FEE_PBPS = 1.
_units.refBandBps: symmetric bps (200=±2%). Active only when refFeedId is set; otherwise MUST be 0 (PoolIO: refBand = refFeedId≠0 && refBandBps≠0).

stable-core._paramNote: 2026-07-12 postmortem: minFee 0.1bp + center-bump + kappaCov=0 let bots drain FDUSD→USDC and dump BTCB into volatile. New floors: stable minFee 0.5bp (50 PBPS), gamma 2× inventory skew, flatter profile. FDUSD minFee 1bp. θ stays 0.25bp (mark cadence ≠ fee floor).
stable-core._perAssetNote: minDispersion = observed tight trading-band WIDTH in PBPS (100 PBPS=1bp), mark-relative. FDUSD raised (peg ~0.997 + prior drain). Shape: 4-knot mild center bump — 50% depth in center 24% of band (~2× vs flat, was 3.1×).

depositCapScheduleUsd._comment: Testnet growth schedule $50K->$1M. Per-asset split = observed 3mo stable-stable volume weights (base USDC 35%, USDT 26%, USD1 27%, FDUSD 8.5%, USDe 3.5%). USDe kept tiny (near-0 BSC flow + depeg risk). Raise the active tier via setAssetParams as TVL fills; win-share by count (~23%) is TVL-invariant, volume-share and abs fees scale up ($8k/yr@50K -> $111k/yr@1M).

markSource._comment: The keeper reads NXR REST marks and pushes them to ExternalOracle under the deviation-θ, confidence-spike and heartbeat policy. NXR is the sole BTR-facing market-data boundary.

volatile-core._paramNote: Fee charged = pathSpread/2 (Pricing.sol). Mean arb gate: center_error_mean ≤ minFee/2. θ=5 + heartbeat=300; minFee 10bp. gamma 2× after 2026-07-12 BTCB dump (inventory skew was too soft).

sharedRiskConfig._kappaNote: kappaCov>0 needs depthAmplifier=0 (enforced). Leave 0 until a dedicated coverage-wall pass; rely on gamma + higher minFee for now.

sharedLiquidityProfile._comment: Milder center bump post 2026-07-12: knots ±50 / ±12; weights [50,100,50] ≈ 50% depth in center 24% (~2× vs flat; was [25,150,25] ≈3.1×).

feeFloorsHuman.note: Launch revision 2026-07-12: stable ~0.5bp (50 PBPS; FDUSD 1bp) with θ=0.25; volatile 10bp with θ=5 + heartbeat 300s. Fee charged is half path spread.
